newsitem.title: USA: Somerset votes 5-for-4 split, div hike.
newsitem.headline: Somerset votes 5-for-4 split, div hike.

text.p: Somerset Group Inc said Wednesday its board voted a five-for-four split, increasing its shares outstanding by 25 percent.
The board also approved paying a semi-annual cash dividend of $0.09 per share which, after giving effect to the split, results in a 12-1/2 percent increase in annual cash dividend payments.
The stock split will be issued on March 14 to holders of record on February 26.
The semi-annual dividend will be paid on March 29 to holders of record on March 21.

Somerset Group, a financial services company, said the split is the second time within a year that the company's stock has split and the cash dividend was increased. In March 1996, the common stock split five-for-four and cash dividends paid were increased 25 percent.
After the latest split, the company will have 2,550,152 shares outstanding.
